note: Rewritten from Termitidae (Fauna Sinica, Insecta Vol. 17, Isoptera); original in Chinese; the species is given there under the combination Nasutitermes fulvus Tsai et Chen, 1963 (Acta Entom. Sini. 12(2): 184—185), under a Chinese name meaning "chestnut nasute termite"; here the epithet is placed in the current genus Bulbitermes, whose Chinese generic name means "gourd termite", giving a Chinese name meaning "chestnut gourd termite". The measurement table in the original has only a range column (no holotype column and no mean column), and the pronotum length "0.19—0.19" is transcribed as printed. The caption of fig. 500 is OCR-corrupted to "N. fulznus" in the extracted copy.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish brown, nasus dark brown, abdominal tergites brown, antennae, thorax, legs and ventral abdomen yellow. Head and thorax almost bare, the tip of the nasus with a few short hairs, the posterior margin of the last three abdominal tergites with a few hairs, each ventral abdominal segment with sparse short hairs. Head oval, longer than wide, broadly rounded behind, narrowing anteriorly, not constricted behind the antennal sockets; base of the nasus slightly thicker than its anterior part; in side view the line joining the nasus and the vertex is concave and arched, occasionally with a very indistinct median swelling; the part above the nasus and the mouth lies at a right angle; the anterolateral end of each mandible bears 1 sharp spine. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 equal to or slightly longer than segment 3; the antennae exceed the head length by 1/3. Pronotum small, its anterior part erect and inclined backwards, anterior and posterior margins without a concavity. Abdomen slenderly olive-shaped (fig. 500). Measurements (range): total length 3.57—4.14 mm, head length with nasus 1.47—1.56 mm, head length without nasus 0.92—1.00 mm, head width 0.72—0.87 mm, pronotum length 0.19—0.19 mm, pronotum width 0.43—0.47 mm, hind tibia length 1.15—1.22 mm. Distribution: Yunnan (Mengla, Jinping, 480 m; Jinghong, 500 m).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head brownish yellow, antennae, thorax and abdomen pale yellow to white. Head, thorax and dorsal abdomen with sparse fine short hairs, the ventral abdomen more densely and more longly haired. Head nearly square, widest at the antennae, posterior margin arched, a pale T-shaped stripe dorsally, postclypeus raised, half as long as wide; labrum broadly rounded anteriorly and narrow posteriorly; antennae 15-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3. Pronotum strongly raised, the anterior margin medially concave in some individuals, abdomen swollen and oval. Measurements: total body length 4.43—4.86 mm, head length to the tip of the labrum 1.39—1.47 mm, head width 1.14—1.17 mm, pronotum width 0.58—0.69 mm.
